title: Pet Turnover Surcharge on Lease Term Agreement Lease Breaks — Community Bulletin
content:
**Pet turnover surcharge.** The reletting fee of a lease break on a Lease Term Agreement carries a pet turnover surcharge, set by the household's active Pet Addendum for a pet, never for an assistance animal: an active dog adds 60.00 dollars; any other active pet adds 30.00 dollars; a household with no active pet addendum, or only an assistance animal, adds nothing.

**Records read.** The household's Pet Addendum records in active status, by the animal's species and whether the animal is a pet or an assistance animal approved as a reasonable accommodation.

| Active Pet Addendum on the household | Pet turnover surcharge |
|---|---|
| A dog (a pet) | 60.00 dollars |
| A cat, bird, small caged mammal, fish or reptile (a pet) | 30.00 dollars |
| Only an assistance animal, of any species | nothing |
| No active Pet Addendum | nothing |

**Assembly.** The part of the reletting fee obtained by applying the reletting rate to the contracted rent is rounded half up to the cent, and the surcharge is then added to it.

**Illustrations (hypothetical).** A household with an active Cat Addendum adds 30.00 dollars. A household whose only animal is a dog registered under an Assistance Animal Accommodation adds nothing. A household whose Pet Addendum for a dog has ended adds nothing.
